images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a finished 16:9 desktop wallpaper for The Gilded Hollow Linux desktop theme, ideally 3840 × 2160.
Input image: the attached concept is the edit target and visual reference.
Remove every desktop UI overlay: the entire top status bar, the left application menu, the right settings window, the bottom dock, and the central title, subtitle, ornament and lettering. Seamlessly reconstruct the natural scene behind these objects.
Preserve the beautiful original fantasy mining cavern composition: dark charcoal green stone, moss and tiny mushrooms, soaring stalactites, misty cavern depth, a sparkling stream winding into the distance, delicate wooden bridges and ladders with amber lanterns, small hardworking dwarven miners on the right mining bright seams of gold, one lantern carrier on the left ledge. Preserve the original hand-painted cinematic fantasy illustration style and dwarf character designs. Enrich the subtle stone detail, warm gold reflections in the water, and the restrained lantern glow. Deep forest greens, weathered brass and luminous warm gold, rich shadows, atmospheric depth; elegant rather than excessively saturated. Keep the center-left airy enough for desktop use.
Output only the full-bleed artwork: no text, symbols, logos, panels, desktop icons, dock, borders, or interface. No new unrelated characters or objects.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: left-monitor companion wallpaper for The Gilded Hollow, landscape 16:9, ideally 3840x2160. Input image is a style reference only, specifically the natural fantasy mining cavern behind its UI. Create another view in that same world: a dark, immensely tall mossy cavern with intricate stalactites and weathered wooden bridges, a reflective stream winding from the left foreground into misty depth on the right, small warm brass lanterns along an old mining walkway, one small dwarven lantern-bearer crossing a bridge, a modest ore cart. Deep charcoal-green stone, sage moss, delicate tiny pale mushrooms, muted atmospheric silver mist and rich but restrained warm amber/gold lights. Painterly cinematic fantasy realism with exquisite natural detail and deep perspective. Calm middle distance, inviting magical atmosphere, clear natural textures, luxurious subtle contrast. No interface of any kind, no top bar, dock, menu, panels, icons, frame, logos, lettering or watermark. Edge-to-edge landscape artwork only. Match the reference's lighting, palette and illustration style.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: right-monitor companion wallpaper for The Gilded Hollow, landscape 16:9, ideally 3840x2160. Input image is a style reference only, specifically the natural fantasy mining cavern behind its UI. Create a beautiful different view in this same subterranean world: a tranquil emerald-charcoal cavern pool in the foreground, mossy stone terraces on the right glinting with thin veins of warm gold, a little timber mining lift and lantern-lit wooden walkway disappearing into distant mist, two small dwarven miners with a brass lantern sorting gold beside a minecart. Tall stalactites framing the upper corners, graceful cave opening in the center, layered atmospheric depth, tiny mushrooms and beautiful weathered rock. Preserve the reference's hand-painted cinematic fantasy realism and rich yet muted charcoal greens, sage moss, silver mist and warm golden highlights. Reflections of small lanterns ripple in dark water. Preserve practical quiet negative space. No text, branding, symbols, panels, interface, desktop icons, docks, menus, borders or watermark. Full-bleed wallpaper artwork only.
